subject: dpi.id
name: National foundational digital ID
what_would_settle_it: A named programme, pilot or vendor engagement for a foundational digital-ID system distinct from the passport/civil-registration base already on file.

subject: infra.connect
name: Submarine fibre-optic cable landing
what_would_settle_it: A licensing decision, application, or a dated update to the Submarine Networks registry's coastal-state count.

subject: infra.connect
name: Starlink satellite internet service
what_would_settle_it: A licence application, refusal, or an updated Starlink coverage-map entry for Eritrea.

subject: dpi.pay
name: Mobile money / digital payments service
what_would_settle_it: A named mobile-money operator, licence or pilot, or a central-bank statement on digital payments distinct from the cash-deposit ultimatum.

subject: gov.protect
name: Data-protection law
what_would_settle_it: A published data-protection bill, statute or regulator designation.

subject: gov.legislate
name: Artificial intelligence law and strategy
what_would_settle_it: A published national AI strategy or draft, or any statute or regulation addressed to artificial intelligence.
disposition: absence stands, dated — a June 2026 legal-status review and the 2025 AI readiness index agree that neither a law nor a strategy exists, and the index scores policy capacity at zero

subject: gov.legislate
name: Electronic transactions and e-commerce framework
what_would_settle_it: A proclamation, regulation or gazetted bill giving legal effect to electronic signatures, records or contracts.
disposition: absence stands, dated — the only texts addressing electronic transactions are unofficial consultation drafts from a diaspora legal-reform initiative, with no government process behind them

subject: gov.legislate
name: Freedom of information law
what_would_settle_it: An adopted freedom of information or access to information proclamation, with a request procedure and an appeal route.
disposition: absence stands, dated — a UN review contribution states that no freedom of information law has been adopted; the constitutional guarantee sits in a constitution never brought into force

subject: gov.legislate
name: Statistics law
what_would_settle_it: An enacted statistical proclamation giving the national statistics office a statutory mandate.
disposition: absence stands, dated — a 2007 mid-term review recorded the draft proclamation as submitted and pending, and no later enactment was located

subject: gov.discourse
name: Public discussion of government policy
what_would_settle_it: An independent publication, permitted civil-society body or public forum in which digital or data policy is argued.
disposition: absence stands, dated — a press-freedom index places Eritrea last of 180 for a third consecutive year, and a UN commission found systematic silencing of criticism

subject: dpi.registry
name: National address and postcode system
what_would_settle_it: A national postcode or street-addressing scheme, or a government statement that one is being built.
disposition: absence stands, dated — Eritrea does not appear on the postal union's August 2026 list of countries operating a postcode system, and no other national addressing scheme was located

subject: dpi.registry
name: Voter register
what_would_settle_it: A voter register compiled under the electoral law, or an electoral commission constituted to prepare one.
disposition: absence stands, dated — the electoral law provides for a register, an independent commission and public inspection; nothing records a national election held under it or a register ever compiled

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Online government services
what_would_settle_it: Any citizen-facing online government service — an application, payment, licence or record request completed online.
disposition: absence stands, dated — the customs platform inaugurated in January 2026 is the only operating government digital system on the base, and it serves officials on an intranet

subject: gov.regional
name: Regional shared digital infrastructure
what_would_settle_it: A signed interconnection, cable landing or regional infrastructure agreement naming Eritrea as a participant.
disposition: absence stands, dated — the regional master plan treats Eritrea as a gap to be closed and a later overview records that planned projects carry no commitment to serve Asmara

subject: tech.ai
name: Control of artificial-intelligence abuse
what_would_settle_it: A domestic law, regulator, platform agreement or takedown route addressed to synthetic or manipulated media.
disposition: absence stands, dated — AI-generated war imagery circulated through 2026 met only by external fact-checking; there is no AI law, no data-protection authority and no domestic takedown route
